settings.question: What age is Lingo Leap for?
settings.answer: Lingo Leap is made for children ages 3 and up. If your child has a health condition or takes medication, talk to your pediatrician before starting any new supplement.

settings.question: How do I give Lingo Leap to my child?
settings.answer: Shake well, fill one dropper (1 mL) and give it once a day with food. Give it straight or mix it into juice, milk or a smoothie.

settings.question: What does it taste like?
settings.answer: A natural berry flavour most kids enjoy. If your child is sensitive to flavours, mixing it into their favourite drink works great.

settings.question: When will I see results?
settings.answer: Every child is different. Many parents notice changes in focus and daily routines within 2–4 weeks of consistent daily use. We recommend using Lingo Leap for at least 30–45 days.*

settings.question: The colour looks different or the liquid has separated. Is that okay?
settings.answer: Yes. Zeolite is a natural mineral, so there can be slight colour differences between batches and it can settle in the bottle. Shake well before each use.

settings.question: Can my child take it with other supplements or medication?
settings.answer: If your child takes prescription medication or other supplements, check with your healthcare provider first.

settings.question: Where is Lingo Leap made?
settings.answer: In the USA, in a cGMP-certified facility, and every batch is third-party tested for purity.

settings.question: How does the 30-day money-back guarantee work?
settings.answer: Try Lingo Leap for 30 days. If you’re not happy for any reason, contact our team and we’ll refund you.
